title: Spectral graph edit history and diff use the common model with a retained-byte bound

needles: Spectral edits diff by logical identity: stage config, typed edges and assets
Spectral graph undo and redo restore through the saved-identity loader
Spectral asset history retains a bounded total of bytes and refuses past it
graph edit history bounds retained bytes for ordinary graphs too

installed_sdk.rationale: GraphEditHistory checkpoints and restores spectral graphs through the v7 loader and gains a byte_budget with the ByteBudgetExceeded refusal; GraphDocumentDiff gains spectral_assets_added, spectral_assets_removed and spectral_assets_changed and splits a spectral node's record into spectral.<member> fields.

needles: Spectral asset history retains a bounded total of bytes and refuses past it

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: pulp graph diff reports spectral_assets (added, removed, changed) in JSON and prints spectral asset lines in text; spectral node changes name their spectral.<member> fields. No new command or option is added.

needles: graph diff reports spectral stage, asset and edge changes with MCP parity

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: The MCP pulp_graph diff operation is unchanged; it returns the CLI JSON, which now carries spectral_assets. The CLI test checks that the MCP text equals the CLI JSON byte for byte.

live_product_control.rationale: History restores through GraphSerializer on the caller's thread; a running spectral graph refuses the load and the history reports it. No runtime operation is added.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: No design-time capability or agent manifest entry is added.
